label: ADX (14)
gloss: 14-period average directional index (trend strength, 0–100)

period.description: The indicator’s length: the bars its window reads.

label: Asia 00–08 UTC high
gloss: the highest price of the current Asia 00–08 UTC trading session so far (00:00–08:00 UTC) — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent outside that trading session

label: Asia 00–08 UTC low
gloss: the lowest price of the current Asia 00–08 UTC trading session so far (00:00–08:00 UTC) — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent outside that trading session

label: Asia 00–08 UTC open
gloss: the opening print of the current Asia 00–08 UTC trading session (00:00–08:00 UTC) — a point-in-time read at its own fold, absent outside that trading session

label: ATR (14)
gloss: 14-period average true range, in price units

period.description: The indicator’s length: the bars its window reads.

label: ATR % of price
gloss: average true range as a % of price, (ATR / close) × 100 — the cross-coin comparable form of ATR

label: Inside / outside bar
gloss: the bar's range against the prior bar's: inside when its high is lower and its low higher, outside when its high is higher and its low lower

label: Bar state
gloss: whether the bar is still forming (live, provisional) or already closed

label: Bollinger BandWidth (20, 2)
gloss: Bollinger BandWidth, TradingView’s ta.bbw: the band spread as a % of its own middle band, ((upper − lower) / middle) × 100, comparable across coins

label: Buy pressure
gloss: buy share of traded volume (0–1)

label: Buy pressure (Binance)
gloss: buy share of Binance's spot volume in the bar's period (0–1), from the venue's taker sides

label: Buy pressure (Coinbase)
gloss: buy share of Coinbase's spot volume in the bar's period (0–1), from the venue's taker sides

label: Buy quote volume
gloss: the bar's buy-side traded notional, in USD: the sum of each taker buy's price × size from the live tape; absent for a bar holding a minute the live tape did not cover, never zero

label: Buy trades
gloss: the bar's buy trade count

label: Buy volume
gloss: the bar's buy-side traded volume, in base-asset units

label: Doji
gloss: whether the bar is a doji: its body is at most 0.1× the mean range of the 10 bars before it (TA-Lib CDLDOJI)

label: Engulfing
gloss: whether the bar's body engulfs the prior bar's opposite-colour body, one equal edge allowed (TA-Lib CDLENGULFING): bullish for a white bar over a black one, bearish for the mirror, with no trend context

label: Pin bar
gloss: a pin bar by shape alone, with no trend context: lower_wick when the body is under the mean body of the 10 bars before it, the lower wick is longer than the body and than the upper wick, and the upper wick is under 0.1× their mean range (TA-Lib's hammer shape); upper_wick mirrors it (the shooting-star shape)

label: Candle run
gloss: consecutive candles of this bar's colour ending at this bar, signed: +n white (close at or above open), −n black; capped at ±20

label: Captain confidence
gloss: whether captain concentration is confirmed by flow — false when captExcessZ is below 1.96; true when upLeanZ is at least 1.96 with buyPres_trend rising, or upLeanZ is at most −1.96 with buyPres_trend falling; false otherwise; compared on the unrounded scores; no value without captExcessZ or buyPres_trend

label: CCI (20)
gloss: 20-period commodity channel index (±100 reference)

label: Change (15m)
gloss: the frame price against the open of the 15m bar in force at the frame's instant, ((frame price − 15m bar open) / 15m bar open) × 100 — read live, so it moves until that bar closes

label: Change (1h)
gloss: the frame price against the open of the 1h bar in force at the frame's instant, ((frame price − 1h bar open) / 1h bar open) × 100 — read live, so it moves until that bar closes

label: Change (1d)
gloss: the frame price against the open of the 1d bar in force at the frame's instant, ((frame price − 1d bar open) / 1d bar open) × 100 — read live, so it moves until that bar closes; the 1d bar opens at the UTC day's 00:00, so this is the change since that open — not a rolling 24h change

label: Change (4h)
gloss: the frame price against the open of the 4h bar in force at the frame's instant, ((frame price − 4h bar open) / 4h bar open) × 100 — read live, so it moves until that bar closes

label: Change (5m)
gloss: the frame price against the open of the 5m bar in force at the frame's instant, ((frame price − 5m bar open) / 5m bar open) × 100 — read live, so it moves until that bar closes

label: Close price
gloss: the bar's close price
